scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “A closed Ricci flow with bounded scalar curvature and finite-time curvature blowup” (preprints/A-closed-Ricci-flow-with-bounded-scalar-curvature-and-finite-time-curvature-blowup-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88b1d8270cb2bc5f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At late times on 0 < r ≤ 1 8 √ δ, the reaction quotient c(x, t) = 2⟨Rm(Ric), Ric⟩ | Ric |2 where | Ric | > 0 satisfies both bounds c ≤ 2(q − 1) + C √ q r2 , c ≤ C∗ θ2 . (5.11) Here C is independent of q, k; C∗ may depend on the entire chosen flow. The second bound holds at the pole orbits as well. Globally at positive r, one also has c ≤ D1/r2 for some flow-dependent D1 > 0.
